title: Artin-Rees for coherent modules on a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, i.e. a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] whose underlying space is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals. For a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal M\subseteq\mathcal F$ and $t\ge1$ let $\mathcal I^t\mathcal M\subseteq\mathcal M$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module](0) (the image of the multiplication map $\mathcal I^t\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal M\to\mathcal M$), $\mathcal I^0\mathcal M=\mathcal M$, and for two sub-$\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal M,\mathcal M'\subseteq\mathcal F$ let $\mathcal M\cap\mathcal M'$ be the sectionwise intersection, $(\mathcal M\cap\mathcal M')(W)=\mathcal M(W)\cap\mathcal M'(W)$. Then there is an integer $c\ge0$ such that $\mathcal I^{n-c}(\mathcal I^c\mathcal F\cap\mathcal G)=\mathcal I^n\mathcal F\cap\mathcal G$ for all $n\ge c$; in particular $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F\cap\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal I^{n-c}\mathcal G$ for all $n\ge c$.

proof.text: Coherence gives quasi-coherence by isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType. Apply the existing public coherent_affine_sections_finite theorem on each affine open to obtain Module.Finite for F(U). No copied restriction helper or finite generation of G(U) is needed.

Apply Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul to the image N_U of g(U) in F(U), obtaining k_U. Compactness gives a finite affine subcover s. Let c be Finset.sup s k, with zero for the empty cover. For k_U ≤ c ≤ n, apply the module equality at n and c; Submodule.mul_smul, pow_add and (n-c)+(c-k_U)=n-k_U give the equality at the common bound c.

The affine comparison converts this fixed-exponent module equality to range equality on every subopen of each covering affine. For arbitrary W use the cover W ∩ U. For a monomorphism, local section preimages are compatible by injectivity and naturality; the sheaf gluing axiom gives a global preimage. Apply this proved private range-locality lemma in both directions to descend the equality on W ∩ U to W.

Apply formalModuleQuotient_factor to pullback.snd a g with both exponents n-c, where a is the inclusion I^c F → F. Its commutative square, followed by g, and pullback.condition identify the left-hand inclusion with a composite through I^(n-c) G. Evaluating at W and using the equality of the previous step yields the claimed range inclusion.
